answer: One strong defence is stake-bonded identity: every agent locks a deposit that is slashed when it is caught running duplicate personas, so a Sybil farmer pays per fake instead of cloning for free. Like a wharf charging each ship to dock, the bond makes every extra identity expensive. Peers then mirror-check behaviour across the garden of public attestations, and a cluster of identical histories exposes the copies, so the attacker funds their own detection.
